summary: Build PMO dashboards and automate reporting with Excel, Power BI, and Power Automate. Learn practical workflows for faster, clearer decisions.
lede: PMO reporting automation combines Power BI dashboards with structured project data and repeatable workflows to create decision-ready reports. For PMO analysts, coordinators and reporting specialists, the course covers shaping data with Power Query, visualizing project health, and setting up scheduled status packs and RAID rollups with Power Automate, alongside checks for reporting quality.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who produce, review, or govern project and portfolio reporting. It is especially relevant if you manage recurring status cycles, dashboard updates, escalation packs, or executive summaries in a PMO or transformation office. PMO Analysts who consolidate status data and build recurring dashboards. PMO Coordinators who prepare weekly and monthly reporting packs. Project Reporting Specialists who manage project health metrics and visuals. Portfolio Managers who review cross-project performance and escalation trends. Transformation Office Analysts who track initiative progress and governance actions. Programme Support Officers who compile RAID logs and milestone updates. PMO Managers who standardize reporting templates and review cadence. Project Control Analysts who monitor schedule, cost, and resource data. Business Transformation Leads who need leadership-ready reporting packs. Operational Excellence Specialists who support dashboard governance and process control.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop with Microsoft Excel installed. Access to Power BI Desktop and Microsoft Power Automate is recommended for hands-on workflow exercises, and a sample project status dataset or your own anonymized reporting data will improve relevance.
